response: For an ordinary prose-specified task with integration-level complexity, do not attempt either unavailable Superpowers role and do not claim that a generic agent is typed. Dispatch the implementer with agent_type="worker", fork_turns="none", model="gpt-5.6-terra", reasoning_effort="medium", and a fully substituted implementer-prompt.md message. After DONE or properly routed DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, generate the review package from the BASE recorded before implementation through the current HEAD, then dispatch a fresh reviewer with agent_type="default", fork_turns="none", model="gpt-5.6-sol", reasoning_effort="high", and a fully substituted task-reviewer-prompt.md message. The reviewer remains read-only and must return both spec-compliance and task-quality verdicts. Record the unavailable typed roles and the actual fallback dispatches in this plan's ledger, then, only after an approved review, append the normal task-complete line. No human stop is required merely because typed roles are absent; the baseline's explicit-model fallback applies.
